_comment: RushPoint ('Race to Tzion') workspace profile. ALL RushPoint-specific content extracted from the generic engine lives here: the curated backlog seed, the task selection filters (rebuild / UI-freeze regexes), the goal/phase taxonomy, and the implementer prompt conventions. RushPoint is now JUST ONE profile — selecting a different workspace selects a different profile, and the engine itself contains no RushPoint strings.

promptProfile:
RushPoint v2 conventions (web platform — creator-web + play-web, NO mobile/Expo):
- Two apps: apps/creator-web (React+Vite, creator console) and apps/play-web (React+Vite PWA, participant). Shared types in packages/shared; Cloud Functions in functions/.
- Never hardcode Firestore path strings — use FIRESTORE_PATHS from @rushpoint/shared. Multi-tenant model: users/{uid}/games/{gameId}/runs/{runId}/teams/{teamId}.
- Run/team/score docs are server-write-only (Cloud Functions, Admin SDK); clients are read-only per firestore.rules. Add new mutations as callables in functions/, not client writes, and expose them via the app's services/calls.ts wrapper.
- creator-web auth is real Firebase Auth (email/Google); play-web is anonymous (uid == teamId). Staff sign in via PIN -> staffSignIn custom token.
- Tailwind: static class strings only (no dynamic bg-${x}). creator-web uses dark theme tokens; play-web uses the light 'Warm Trail' theme (accent #F97316).
- Scoring is one of 3 automatic presets (time_only / fixed_points_speed / smart_weighted) - NO human judge input. See packages/shared/scoringPresets.ts.
- Honor this repo's CLAUDE.md / INSTRUCTIONS.md and the v2 spec.
- Required gates: 'npm run typecheck' and 'npm run creator:build' both pass.

seed.title: Wire real Firebase Storage photo uploads for photo tasks in play-web (replace the upload:// placeholder so photo missions actually work)
seed.notes: In apps/play-web, PhotoEntry inside src/components/TaskRunner.tsx currently sets the photo URL to 'upload://' + filename — a placeholder that never uploads. Fix: import firebase/storage in src/services/firebase.ts (wire connectStorageEmulator to 127.0.0.1:9199 in dev), upload the picked File to a path like runs/{runId}/teams/{teamId}/{taskId}-{timestamp}.jpg, await getDownloadURL, then pass that real URL to submitStationPhoto. Keep the autoApprove path working (submitStationPhoto already auto-completes when smart.autoApprove). Show an uploading spinner. Required gates: typecheck + creator:build. Add storage rules to storage.rules allowing authed writes under runs/**.

seed.title: Build the Staff console in play-web: PIN sign-in, photo review (approve/reject), SOS acknowledge, and send announcements
seed.notes: New staff surface in apps/play-web (e.g. a /staff route or a mode toggle on the join screen). Flow: staff enters ownerUid/gameId/runId + PIN (the host shares a join link encoding these) -> call staffSignIn callable -> signInStaff(customToken). Then show: (1) pending photo submissions to approve/reject via reviewStationSubmission; (2) active SOS alerts to acknowledge via acknowledgeAlert; (3) an announcement composer via pushAnnouncement. All callables already exist in functions/src/index.ts and are typed in services/calls.ts (add the missing wrappers). Staff has NO score access. Light 'Warm Trail' theme. Required gates: typecheck + creator:build (play-web build non-blocking).

seed.title: Add a map-based location picker in the creator Builder and a list+map gallery view (spec section 10 + 13b)
seed.notes: Two parts, ship incrementally. (1) apps/creator-web BuilderPage TaskEditor currently has raw lat/lng number inputs — add a MapLibre map (maplibre-gl is already a dependency; reuse the rendering pattern in apps/creator-web/src/components/LiveTeamMap.tsx) where the creator clicks to drop/move a pin that writes task.coordinates; keep the numeric inputs as a fallback. (2) apps/creator-web GalleryPage currently only lists games — add a list/map toggle that plots each public game at its approxLocation. Required gates: typecheck + creator:build.

seed.title: Surface announcements, flash missions, and the live leaderboard inside play-web so participants see live-ops broadcasts
seed.notes: In apps/play-web PlayScreen, the backend already writes announcements + flashMissions under the run (pushAnnouncement / pushFlashMission), and firestore.rules allow any authed participant to READ those run subcollections. Add onSnapshot listeners on users/{ownerUid}/games/{gameId}/runs/{runId}/announcements (active==true) and /flashMissions (isActive + not expired) and render them as a non-blocking banner/toast (do not cover the map or task card). Also add a collapsed 'leaderboard peek' that reads run.leaderboard when present. Use the existing dialog/ui components + light theme. Required gates: typecheck + creator:build.
